status: Revised proposed offer, not contracted or buyer-validated
niche: US residential retail roof-replacement contractors using JobNimbus, with 200 eligible unsold estimates from the last 90 days and capacity to fulfil more jobs
problem: Paid-for enquiries and delivered estimates go quiet; follow-up and reply ownership are inconsistent.
solution: Connect eligible estimates to AI-assisted follow-up, approved answers, human sales handoffs, stop rules and outcome tracking.
offer: Turn unsold roof estimates into sold jobs and cash collected. If the agreed recovery target is missed, continue the agreed follow-up work without a management fee until it is met.
qualification: 200 unique, contactable retail replacement estimates issued in the past 90 days
No won/lost/opted-out, active sales conversations or insurance-only claims
Appropriate permission for selected contact channels
A named rep with available review slots and access to agreed records
result_definition: Verified cash collected against agreed reopened estimate cohort, net of refunds. Attributed cash is distinct from proven incremental revenue.
conditions: Target and measurement period agreed in writing after pipeline review. Continued management fee waived after a miss while the agreed eligible pipeline, access and sales cooperation are available. Third-party costs remain payable; no arbitrary cash target invented.
scope: Data clean-up and suppression rules for the agreed cohort
Quote-specific SMS/email sequences and approved FAQ replies
Human escalation for price, finance, technical advice and complaints
Weekly reconciliation of replies, held reviews and actual sales
evidence: See research.html; competitor results are not Roofline results.
commercial_terms: Pricing discussed privately after qualification; no public price or waived dollar amount.
